app.name: SpecStream
app.short_description: Company facts from the live web in your ticket sidebar, each with its source
app.long_description:
Know who's writing in before you reply. SpecStream reads the live web for the company behind a ticket and puts the facts in the sidebar: website, employee count, industry, headquarters, country, year founded, LinkedIn page and latest funding round. Every value links to the page it was read on, so an agent can check it in one click.

**How it works**

- Open a ticket. SpecStream takes the company from the requester's organization, or from their email domain, and writes the request for you. Change it to ask for anything else on the web: the head of support, open roles, a recent press release.
- See the price before anything runs. The default company profile is 15¢. You pay for each result delivered, and a lookup that finds nothing is free.
- Approve, and the results arrive in the sidebar in a few minutes. Leave the ticket and come back; they wait there, and every lookup is saved as a list in your SpecStream workspace.
- Save values to the organization. SpecStream matches organization fields named like Website, Employees or Industry, and fills the ones you tick.

SpecStream also sits in the organization sidebar, so you can look up any organization from its own page.

**Your data**

SpecStream receives only the request an agent approves: by default the organization's domain or name, or the requester's email domain, plus anything the agent types. It never receives ticket comments, requester names or email addresses. Values saved to an organization go straight from the sidebar to your Zendesk account. The API key stays in Zendesk's secure settings, and every call goes through Zendesk's proxy to api.specstream.ai only. Privacy policy: https://specstream.ai/privacy

SpecStream is the live web data engine for teams and agents. New accounts start with $10 of credit, no card.
app.installation_instructions:
1. Create a SpecStream account at https://specstream.ai/signup. New accounts start with $10 of credit, no card.
2. In SpecStream, open **Agents & API** (https://specstream.ai/workspace/agents) and create an API key.
3. Install the app and paste the key into **SpecStream API key**. Zendesk keeps it secret: agents never see it, and Zendesk adds it to each request to api.specstream.ai.
4. Open any ticket. SpecStream is in the apps panel on the right, and on every organization's page.

To save values to organizations, add organization fields such as Website, Employees or Industry in Admin Center, under **People > Configuration > Organization fields**. Agents need permission to edit organizations to save.

Help: https://specstream.ai/docs/integrations/zendesk or support@specstream.ai
